headword: {連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}

definitions.gloss: serialized novel; serial novel; novel published in installments
definitions.explanation: A novel published in successive installments in a newspaper, magazine, or online platform.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read the serialized novel in the newspaper every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: That author's serialized novel starts next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完結|かんけつ}→完結：12279_kanketsu⟧し、⟦{単行本|たんこうぼん}→単行本：11937_tankoubon⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The popular serialized novel was completed and published as a book.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧ (serialization) + ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (novel). A major tradition in Japanese publishing — many famous Japanese novels were originally serialized in newspapers or literary magazines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a serialized novel
- {連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完結|かんけつ}する→完結する：20679_kanketsusuru⟧: for a serialized novel to conclude
- ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧{連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}: newspaper serial novel

CULTURAL NOTE:
Newspaper serialization has been central to Japanese literary culture since the Meiji era. Many classic works by ⟦{夏目漱石|なつめそうせき}→夏目漱石：30575_natsumesouseki⟧, {川端康成|かわばたやすなり}, and others first appeared as {連載小説|れんさいしょうせつ}. Today, web novels ({ウェブ小説|うぇぶしょうせつ}) have become a modern form of serialization.
